corpus: insurance_docs/ six-endorsement drop (HO-0304, HO-0412, HO-0521, HO-0633, HO-0710, DP-0208)
notes: These eight questions were written from the endorsement text BEFORE any
search was run against the new index, and the file was committed before
the first retrieval. Writing questions after looking at what retrieval
returns measures the question-writing, not the chunker.
Ground truth is recorded three ways, because the three are useful for
different things and only one of them is chunker-independent:
form_number + clause  the human-checkable answer location, and what a
citation in a generated answer has to name.
anchors               literal substrings of the endorsement, each one
contained on a SINGLE line of the extracted text.
This is the scoring criterion: a retrieved chunk
is a hit when it comes from the right form AND
contains an anchor. Chunk ids change with every
chunking strategy, so a chunk-id label would make
the two strategies incomparable - which is the
one thing this exercise cannot afford.
relevant_pages        retained so the existing page-overlap metrics in
rag/evaluation.py still run over this set.
Anchors are deliberately single-line. A multi-line anchor would fail on
any strategy that re-joins line breaks differently, and would score the
text-joining rather than the chunking.

cases.question: Does exclusion E-17 apply to water damage from a burst supply line under HO-0304 ed. 03-24?
anchors: Constant or repeated seepage or leakage of water occurring over a period of fourteen
cases.known_answer: No. E-17 excludes constant or repeated seepage over fourteen days or more. A burst supply line is a sudden and accidental discharge under Clause 2.1 and remains covered, subject to the Clause 5.3 deductible.

cases.question: Under HO-0412, is cosmetic hail damage to roof surfacing covered if the roof still sheds water?
anchors: Cosmetic damage to roof surfacing that does not compromise the water-shedding function of
cases.known_answer: No. E-34 excludes cosmetic damage to roof surfacing absolutely where the water-shedding function is not compromised.

cases.question: If the insured never serviced the sump pump, is the resulting back-up covered under HO-0521?
anchors: Back-up or overflow caused by the failure of the insured to maintain, service or test the
cases.known_answer: No. E-44 excludes absolutely a back-up or overflow caused by failure to maintain, service or test the sump pump to the manufacturer schedule.

cases.question: Under HO-0633, does exclusion E-53 bar a bodily injury claim by a home-sharing guest when the home was rented for only 10 days in the policy year?
anchors: Bodily injury to a home-sharing occupant however caused
total number of days on which any part of the dwelling is rented does not exceed fourteen
cases.known_answer: No. E-53 is disapplied by Clause 4.2 where total rental in the policy year is within the fourteen day allowance in Clause 4.1, so a 10-day rental leaves the claim to be adjudicated under the base liability coverages.

cases.question: What is the mould sublimit for a covered water damage loss under HO-0304?
anchors: Our total liability for mould, fungus or wet rot
cases.known_answer: Ten thousand dollars ($10,000) in any one policy year, part of and not in addition to the Coverage A limit.

cases.question: What windstorm and hail deductible applies under HO-0412?
anchors: two percent (2%) of the Coverage A limit
cases.known_answer: Two percent of the Coverage A limit shown in the declarations, per windstorm or hail loss, subject to a minimum of $1,000. It replaces the all-perils deductible.

cases.question: How does HO-0710 define 'sudden and accidental'?
anchors: abrupt in onset and unintended by the insured
cases.known_answer: An event both abrupt in onset and unintended by the insured, occurring at an identifiable point in time. A process developing gradually over fourteen days or more is not sudden and accidental and is adjudicated as seepage.

cases.question: What is the aggregate annual limit for water back-up losses under HO-0521?
anchors: twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) in the aggregate
cases.known_answer: Twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) in the aggregate for all losses in any one policy year, part of and not in addition to the Coverage A limit.

cases.question: What is the reserve-setting threshold for claim CLM-2024-88431?
cases.known_answer: Not in the corpus. Reserve-setting thresholds live in the adjuster system, which was never indexed. The correct behaviour is refusal.

cases.question: Which adjuster is assigned to claim CLM-2024-88431, and what is their settlement authority?
cases.known_answer: Not in the corpus. Adjuster assignment and authority limits are claims-system records, not policy wording. The correct behaviour is refusal.

cases.question: What is the current replacement-cost valuation on file for the dwelling at 42 Ridgeline Drive?
cases.known_answer: Not in the corpus. Property-level valuations live in the underwriting system; the endorsements state how a loss is settled, never the sum insured for a specific address. The correct behaviour is refusal.
